description: This file defines the 'FormatWithEducation' class, which implements value formatting for Education entities within the OrangeHRM system. It retrieves an Education object by ID and returns its name, serving as a formatter strategy for displaying education-related information.

classes.name: FormatWithEducation
classes.description: A class implementing the ValueFormatter interface to format education entities into displayable strings based on their ID.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Retrieves the education name based on the provided entity value (assumed to be an ID), returning null if not found or not an Education instance.

methods.name: getEducationService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of EducationService used to fetch Education entities.
